notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE - V1.4.0 - Shocking Development!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/cb04d2b1a04d7d1f85319f19556b6236e3648787.jpg[/img]

Oh [b]WOW![/b] There is so much exciting and cool stuff in V1.4.0, we cannot wait to hear your feedback!

[h1]EASY means EASY[/h1]
We have listened to your feedback and we have to put our hands up and admit that we really buggered it up!

SteamHammerVR has three settings; EASY, MEDIUM and HARD but it turns out that they basically may as well have been labelled EXTREMELY CHALLENGING, DIE DIE DIE and HA HA HA HA NO CHANCE SUCKER!!!

So in Version 1.4.0 Easy means Easy, in fact, it is so easy that we are supremely confident that at least one of you can make it past Mission Four....YES! NOBODY has yet made it past Mission Four of the Eleven Story Mode Missions, which means that you have all been missing out on some totally stunning (albeit foggy) parts of London, not to mention a great story! How stupid do we feel? Pretty stupid, Welcome to Dumbass Central :-) 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/a3c539d9544d065c9b364c78a2da455b2822a139.jpg[/img]

So along with all the new the changes, the Audio Hints switched on and the 'Hintenburg' Mini Airship to guide your way, you can go in now and play the whole game on EASY or for the masochists among you, you can try it on hard!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/ff5c95ce6c34dd5e90c461f9e532fe2444c49dd5.jpg[/img]

[h1]ENGLISH SUBTITLES[/h1]
There is quite a lot of jolly English banter and idioms in the game dialogue that some may not be very familiar with, as such the entire game can now be played with English Subtitles!

[h1]CHINESE VERSION & SUBTITLES 中文版和字幕 [/h1]
We have included our first full translation of the SteamHammerVR into Simplified Chinese. How cool is that? It's just a shame we didn't keep the interpreter long enough to write this update in Chinese!!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/13309055ad737cc387e7a01079e8cfdf553f7e1d.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDED BUGS SOME TAKEN OUT[/h1]
Massive sweep of the game to clear out some niggling bugs a few of you may have encountered, plus we put a few bugs in...Automaton types, not like code bugs, that would be very silly!

[h1]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Total Framework Rebuild for Future HMD Support
[*] Dominant Hand Option
[*] Advanced Topiary Design
[*] Even More 3D Spatial Audio Enhancements
[*] Bench Plaque Humour Auto Generation & Deployment
[*] HeroLite™ Enhanced Gameplay
[*] Over 112 Devilishly Subtle Enhancements, Tweaks and Improvements that when you spot them you will go, "Oh WOW! That is so damn cool! We love you guys! I am SO sharing this with EVERYBODY!"
[/list]

notes.title: Oculus Touch Now Supported + New Enhancements v1.3.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/58caa0cca6b40ebe0669682d6aaec5605b718f86.jpg[/img]

We are delighted to announce that the world of SteamHammerVR - The Rogue Apprentice is now open to be explored by owners of the Oculus Touch.

Included in the release of v1.3.0 we have also made the following improvements.

[list]
    [*]New Optional Visual & Audio Help prompts throughout (Introducing the 'Hintenburg')
    [*]Blink Teleport (Optional)
    [*]Improved lighting
    [*]Further 3D spatial audio enhancements
    [*]Rotation Assist (Oculus)
    [*]Over 42 other little tweaks and pulls to make your journey back to London 1892 not only memorable but also aesthetically utterly pleasing.
[/list]

notes.title: Full Release Coming - 31st July 2017 17:00 PST
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/da1068930a56a92e6744dc4f1fbaa6a88e4b629c.png[/img]

Announcing the full release of SteamHammerVR - The Rogue Apprentice which will be available on the 31st July 2017 17:00 PST.

We would like to take this opportunity to thank all those who supported us by purchasing the Early Access version and giving us such positive feedback on how we should improve the game, we are absolutely sure you will be blown away when your copy updates.

[h1]What's changed?[/h1]

[h1]Story Mode[/h1] 'The Rogue Apprentice' now contains [b]Eleven Missions[/b] which take you on a story based adventure staged in some of the most iconic locations around Victorian London, including, The Tower of London, Limehouse Warehouse, Trafalgar Square, Westminster, St Pauls and even the famous London Sewers. It's a hugely engaging and immersive experience with several types of challenging gameplay.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/987ba3202dfe807b602a9bc5518d02038af309a2.png[/img]

As the narrative unravels you will unlock each mission. more of the story and more powerful weapons, there are plenty of twists and surprises to enjoy as you discover the truth about your recruitment as 'The SteamHammer'

[h1]Seek & Destroy Mode[/h1] Seek & Destroy mode now gives you [b]Four[/b] full on 'Arcade Wave Shooting' versions of SteamHammerVR, with a mass of combos to boost your score, see how far you can battle your way to the top of the Global Leaderboards! Try your hand at 'Panic on the Streets of London' , Have a pint in the Skillington Arms for the hilarious 'Bar Room Brawl', keep an eye on the time in Westminster for the 'Big Ben Bash' or go to the Tower of London for a 'Kick in the Crown Jewels'!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/b84847916a1c65195dd04d77e3424f71c5feb386.png[/img]

[h1]Exceptionally Community Driven Features[/h1]
[list][*]Unique VR Combat: With six different weapons and two hands you have over 36 weapon combinations with an amazing amount of physics to master.[/list]
[list][*]Voice Commands: Want to keep you finger securely on the tigger? No problem, you can use several one word voice commands to instantly switch your weapon load out mid battle[/list]
[list][*]4 Camera Angles and Auto Camera Switch for Monitors: See all the action from several angles or just let 'auto cam' switch between them[/list]
[list][*]Challenging and Not so Challenging: Easy, Medium and Hard settings available for all modes[/list]
[list][*]Testing Range: Before you go into the fray you can test all the functionality of your Exo-Suit and weapons[/list]
[list][*]An Amazing Original Soundtrack album from Polish sound Magician Przemek Kasperski is included with the game[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/babadc95a307ccf566fd2f9c4077ed14476af93a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Helmet Upgrade with Voice Commands! Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/babadc95a307ccf566fd2f9c4077ed14476af93a.jpg[/img]

Announcing a small but totally splendiferous update prior to the complete release scheduled for Summer 2017.

[h1]Voice Commands[/h1]
As well as switching your weapons using the pads, you can now switch your weapon load out by saying the following voice commands:

[h1]HAMMERS[/h1]Two Pneumatic Hammers
[h1]SNIPER[/h1]Two Rail Guns
[h1]ATTRACTION[/h1]Magnet Beam and Pneumatic Hammer
[h1]MAGNETS[/h1]Two Magnet Beams
[h1]ELECTROCUTE[/h1] Tesla Ray and Steam Cannon
[h1]TESLA[/h1] Two Tesla Rays
[h1]STEAM[/h1] Steam Cannon and Pneumatic Hammer
[h1]DEFENDER[/h1]Rail Gun and Pneumatic Hammer

[h1]Other Key Release Notes for 1.1.1[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Headshots are now more effective against Humanoid Automatons
    [*]4 Camera Angles and Auto Camera Switch for Monitors
    [*]Over 42 improvements and tweaks throughout
[/list]

NOTE: For Voice Command to work your HMD will need to have its microphone active.

notes.title: Seek & Destroy Mode LIVE! - Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/6489c50adfaf3ed84d301ecfd9ff2506cc882fdf.jpg[/img]

So folks! This is the last update before we come out of Early Access on the 31st May 2017.

In this latest release there have been several further tweaks and improvements to the Story Mode gameplay, but now you can access Seek & Destroy arcade Mode and try one of four gameplay zones.

[h1] Seek & Destroy Mode[/h1]
Seek & Destroy is an arcade style time based full on wave shooter version of SteamHammerVR with plenty of combos to boost your score and rack up those achievements. Ultimately your quest here is to try to become the world's most successful SteamHammer!

For Seek & Destroy you have been given MKIII versions of the SteamHammer arsenal, but you can still test your skill by playing in Easy, Medium or Hard. 

Note: If you want to ascend the leaderboard and achieve the title of the Supreme SteamHammer then you can accumulate more points playing on the harder difficulty levels.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/8a916f4585089aab22701bf12ee6ddb6b4c459bf.jpg[/img]

[h1] [u]Full Release Details[/u][/h1]

[h1]The Rogue Apprentice - Story Mode (Ten Missions)[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Streets of London (Available in Early Access)
    [*]The Skillington Arms (Available in Early Access)
    [*]The Tower of London (Available in Early Access)
    [*]The Sewers (Available in Early Access)
    [*]Limehouse Warehouse
    [*]Trafalgar Square
    [*]Eastenders
    [*]Night on the Town
    [*]The Palace
    [*]Rattwurms Mansion
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/41a7867fb0ffc35d07b7eba230fc6c2ad2b4735b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Seek & Destroy Game Zones[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Panic on the Streets of London (Available in Early Access)
    [*]Pandemonium at St Pauls
    [*]Pain in the Drain
    [*]Kick in the Crown Jewels
[/list]

[h1]DUO Mode - Seek & Destroy Multiplayer[/h1]
Take to the streets with a friend, plan your strategy and save old London Town


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/ca13ca241cb4e5850b5c22aa1f881f7d35f11912.jpg[/img]

notes.title: An AMAZing Update - V1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/d06984c28fb23c065ce45e76ebebf2f690177e3b.png[/img]

Oh boy! Have we created a real stink with this one!

Yes! The new [b]Sewers Mission[/b] is now available for all our intrepid SteamHammerers.

You will certainly need your wits about you, as well as a peg for your nose and a good sense of direction, it's a complete maze of tunnels down there!

As you have probably guessed this is not just a pleasant whistle-stop tour of Victorian London's delightful sewer system, there is serious mission work to turn your talents to.

Naturally there are few more of Professor Rattwurm's vile rat automatons lurking in the tunnels but by now we are confident you know how best to deal with those pesky blighters,  however, be advised we heard there are a 'couple' of new enemies for you to combat in the sewers, but don't let that bug you. 
 
Oh...It is a bit gloomy down there but Dr Springhorn has equipped your exo-suit with a nifty little head torch!

Of course it would be jolly helpful if you could find your way out of the sewers by yourself, we are afraid that Dr Springhorn has a rather sensitive disposition to putrid smellls and unidentifiable soft floating debris... that's why he is sending YOU!  Good Luck SteamHammer!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/f9f4013318f064e621ac0107671f911897560663.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's Springhorn been buggering about with?[/h1]

[list]
[*]A double glazing salesman met with Dr Springhorn last week and told him he was using the wrong type of glass in the visor of his exo-suit, so apparently he has replaced it with some new state of the art 'Super Sample' that he gave him to try. 
Tell us what your think of the new Super-Sample-Thing will you? Oh sorry, apparently its Supersampling whatever the hell that is! Check it out in your SteamHammer Menu.

[*]Springhorn is a bit confused this week, we asked him to fix some bugs, which is apparently why we got sent to the Sewers ;-) See what we did there?
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/a5c75fed75cc598109258c9ed93135ce38795db6.png[/img]

[h1]What Crazy, Cruel and Unusual Creations come next?[/h1]

[list]
[*] Assuming you have made it out of the sewers and have had a jolly rigorous scrub down then you can next venture along the River Thames to the Limehouse Warehouse...we hope you have developed a good gameplay strategy by now, here you are going to have to think as well as fight...and run.

[*] Time to tell you a little bit more about [b]Seek and Destroy Mode[/b], some of the locations you may recognise from the Story Mode but the gameplay and the automaton combinations here are going to test your strategy, survival instinct and weapon combos to the limit, are you the best SteamHammerer on the planet? Let's find out!

[*]Feeling lonely? Need someone to cover your back? Want to reign supreme over the villainous Rattwurm's automaton army with a buddy? That's [b]DUO Mode[/b]...more announcements on that totally cool potato soon!
[/list]

notes.title: Tinkering Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/1435bbbb7fb5e45a3f42c686800b7e05350fd1e1.png[/img]
Dr Springhorn has been busily tinkering away since last weeks launch and is tickled pink to announce the splendiferous version 1.0.3

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Game Tips[/b] - Yes we know you are big enough to look after yourself and this is doubtlessly stuff you already know, but some people aren’t quite as smart and devastatingly good looking as you. 
[*][b]Gag the Doctor[/b] - Well I say! I don’t know what to say, apparently you don’t need reminding about the mission every time you go in and try again #Shhhhhhhh #GagSpringhorn 
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/18940c9c3d88bc146e3c1ac3bae87ca82435bcaf.png[/img]

[h1]What ‘Features' Have Been Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]♫'You are So Beautiful..'♫ [/b] - Further testing revealed an inconsistency in the optimum beautification on certain hardware set ups, this has been rectified and now everything looks rather splendid for everyone.
[*][b]I am Weak !! [/b]- Ok so you picked Easy because your a Feak and Weeble, we appreciate that we shouldn’t sneakily move it back to the recommended Medium.
[*][b]Overfed Ravens [/b]- Rumours came in that Rattwurms largest Ravens had become rather cumbersome due to incorrect allocating of oil rations, after an new regime and several sackings they are now much faster and direct in their attacks, Yes we knew you would be pleased!
[*][b]Hands on in the Hordenburg [/b]- Point, poke or jab, we all like to used a gloved hand our own way, so all the buttons will now respond however badly you treat them.
[/list]

[h1]What’s Coming Next?[/h1]

[b]The SEWERS Mission[/b]
Get your wellies and a peg for your nose, as it is really rather smelly down here, but apparently there has been an infestation of CLOCKROACHES!! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/c0346542504722f21492388d06973eda1cd303c4.png[/img]

[b]SEEK AND DESTROY[/b]
It is nearly time to rip that unsightly plaster from the Game type telegraph, what exactly is Seek and Destroy anyway? well, YOU are the SteamHammer, but apparently there are others who think they are more up to the job than you…soon you will get the chance to prove them wrong!

p.s. We know the more historically savvy of you will have been utterly perplexed and in some cases incensed as to how Dr Springhorn is using a sticking plaster which allegedly was not invented until 1920, but in actual fact the patent was stolen from Obadiah.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26240199/a66687cea667e84bd670dc8c786bb9fc330a0600.png[/img]

notes.title: Powering UP! 1.1.0.preview
notes.content:
Thank you for all the great feedback from the community, work is full steam ahead on the full version of SteamHammerVR to be release on 9th December 2016.

However...based upon that feedback we decided we should make a few tweaks to the preview version also.

[b]Update 1.1.0.preview[/b]

[list]
    [*] HUD:  Better visibility of HUD's in the upper left and upper right corner of the screen.
    [*] BEAUTY: Following an update to Unity Engine a major rework has been implemented to the lighting and shaders, this should address issues that some users had viewing certain game elements and in fact....it now looks even more beautiful!
    [*] RATS: Rats are now faster, especially those tiny blighters!!
    [*] WAVE SAVE: Waves are now automatically saved, you can start again from where you left off or clear the game to go for it again.
    [*]  #STEAMSECRET No.2 added - Another chance to win the game and be immortalised in VR gaming history. Find the clues and tweet the 'word' along with the tags #SteamSecrets and #SteamHammerVR
[/list]
